statusVocabulary.REGENERATED: the producer ran on the candidate and its output is retained
statusVocabulary.BYTES-MATCH: two or more independent regenerations, and the committed artifact where one exists, are byte-identical
statusVocabulary.VERDICTS-AGREE: two or more regenerations agree on every verdict and count; bytes not compared
statusVocabulary.PASS-ONLY: only a job or test conclusion exists
statusVocabulary.VALIDATED: the source is the artifact; its validator ran on the candidate and passed
statusVocabulary.RE-MATERIALIZED-VERIFIED: pinned input fetched again and verified against its pins; never rebuilt
statusVocabulary.PRODUCER-FAILS-BY-DESIGN: the producer exits non-zero for a registered reason the inventory records; counts are as registered
statusVocabulary.NOT-REGENERATED-BY-RULE: the inventory or contract forbids or excludes regeneration
statusVocabulary.DETERMINISTIC: the registered determinism protocol's decider returned DETERMINISTIC with complete true
